decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those approved.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling at 98 Merrion Avenue, Stanmore, Harrow, HA7 4RU.&nbsp;

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows / doors other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in any elevation (front, rear and flank) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p>MA98 Existing and Proposed Plans and Elevations (1 – 4 sheets), Location Plan, Planning Statement, Reasonable Exception Statement.&nbsp;</p>
description: Detached single storey outbuilding at rear for use as Gym/Office (Demolition of detached outbuilding to rear)
